metadata.title: LFW Eigenfaces Dataset for PCA Reconstruction

people.name: George W. Bush
people.bio: 43rd President of the United States. Comprises over 41% of the scikit-learn training set.

people.name: Tony Blair
people.bio: British Prime Minister. Second most photographed European leader in LFW.

people.name: Colin Powell
people.bio: First African-American Secretary of State and Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.

people.name: Gerhard Schröder
people.bio: German Chancellor and European political leader heavily represented in LFW.

people.name: Donald Rumsfeld
people.bio: U.S. Secretary of Defense during the 2002–2003 Iraq war news cycle.

people.name: Hugo Chávez
people.bio: Venezuelan President, the only Latin American leader with ≥70 images in LFW.

people.name: Nelson Mandela
people.bio: Anti-apartheid revolutionary, global icon of peace, and Nobel Peace Prize laureate.

people.name: Kofi Annan
people.bio: Ghanaian diplomat, 7th Secretary-General of the United Nations, and Nobel Peace Prize laureate.

people.name: Hu Jintao
people.bio: General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party and President of China.

people.name: Junichiro Koizumi
people.bio: Japanese Prime Minister who was prominent in international diplomacy during 2001–2006.

people.name: Megawati Sukarnoputri
people.bio: First female President of Indonesia and leader of the world's most populous Muslim-majority nation.

people.name: Mahathir Mohamad
people.bio: Architect of Malaysia's modern economic modernization and outspoken Global South leader.

people.name: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
people.bio: 10th Prime Minister of India, statesman, poet, and leader of the world's largest democracy.

people.name: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
people.bio: Prominent Brazilian trade union leader and President of Latin America's largest nation.

people.name: Vicente Fox
people.bio: 55th President of Mexico, whose historic 2000 election ended 71 years of PRI rule.

people.name: Hamid Karzai
people.bio: First democratically elected President of Afghanistan, known for his traditional karakul hat and chapan.

people.name: Serena Williams
people.bio: Widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes of all time, with 23 Grand Slam singles titles.

people.name: Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo
people.bio: 14th President of the Philippines, economist, and second female Philippine president.

people.name: Salma Hayek
people.bio: Mexican and American actress, Academy Award nominee for Frida, and international cultural figure.

people.name: Jackie Chan
people.bio: Hong Kong martial artist, actor, and filmmaker known for his acrobatic fighting style and worldwide fame.

people.name: Condoleezza Rice
people.bio: First African-American female Secretary of State and first female National Security Advisor.

people.name: Jennifer Aniston
people.bio: American actress and global pop culture icon, famous for Friends and Hollywood cinema.

people.name: Arnold Schwarzenegger
people.bio: Austrian-American bodybuilder, Hollywood superstar, and 38th Governor of California.

people.name: Bill Clinton
people.bio: 42nd President of the United States who presided over the longest peacetime economic expansion.
